title: Northbeam TechWorks Quality Office Schedule: Rework, Sign-Off and Workmanship
content:
The quality office of Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair holds five figures for each TechWorks service: the days after completion within which the same fault is put right as rework, whether rework inside that window is carried out without charge, the days the retailer stands behind the workmanship itself, whether the customer must sign the work off before it is recorded complete, and whether photographs of the finished work are kept on file.

| TechWorks service | Rework window, days | Rework inside the window free of charge | Workmanship stood behind for, days | Customer sign-off required | Photographs kept on file |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 30 | yes | 30 | no | no |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 60 | yes | 90 | yes | yes |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 90 | yes | 180 | yes | yes |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 90 | yes | 180 | yes | yes |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 60 | yes | 90 | yes | yes |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 90 | yes | 365 | no | yes |

### Reading the schedule

**The two windows are not the same length.** Only at the store counter do the rework window and the workmanship period coincide, both standing at 30 days. Elsewhere the workmanship period is the longer of the two: 90 days against a 60-day rework window on a standard home installation and on a business deployment, 180 days against 90 on a calibration and on an appliance installation, and 365 days against 90 on the annual care service.

**Rework inside the window is free of charge under every TechWorks service.** All six carry that flag.

**Sign-off and photographs part company at two services.** The bench service asks neither. The annual care service keeps photographs on file but requires no customer sign-off. The remaining four require both.
